review.gallery: Nine clean native project renders from the Azizi Milan community brochure and factsheet. Source scope is the master development. The separate Milan Heights brochure is excluded.
review.location: Regional map checked against the community brochure page 5. The four journey estimates were verified on the visible factsheet panel. Directions use the community name rather than a single building entrance.
review.floorPlans: Five complete original image drawings from the named Property Finder community listing, checked against the displayed type and area references. A second brochure had the same SHA-256 as the separate Milan Heights source and was excluded. The alternative AM-series plan PDFs failed public access or certificate checks. The community brochure is preserved as context.

unavailable: The portal layouts do not specify tower and unit numbers or a duplex area. The complete unit schedule and exact entrance coordinates across the master development were not established.
